title: Small rituals that make a home feel more settled
intro: Simple, low-pressure practices for creating a calmer rhythm where you live.

sections.heading: Clear one surface
sections.body: A small physical reset can give the mind a place to breathe.

sections.heading: Use the senses
sections.body: Light, water, sound, and fresh air can help you return to the present.

sections.heading: Keep it yours
sections.body: A grounding practice should fit your home, beliefs, and daily capacity.
